verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own llms.txt explicitly declares 'Public API: None' because the product is local-first with no agent-callable endpoint. Probes of all standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404. The one page mentioning a '2FAS API' describes, in future tense, a service-side integration for enabling 2FA, not a documented API a user or agent can call to drive the product.
